verdict.rationale: Bento documents maintained first-party packages for JavaScript, Ruby, PHP, Laravel, WordPress, WooCommerce and Next.js. It also has a ClickFunnels integration, an n8n surface, and outbound 'Send webhook' workflow actions. WooCommerce gives one e-commerce connector, and SDKs plus the Events API let you push data from your own app or database. However, none of the integrations named in the story (Stripe, Shopify, Segment) appear in the evidence, and product-database sync requires custom SDK or API work rather than a native connector. Missing for 10: documented Stripe integration, Shopify integration, Segment/CDP integration, native product-database connector, independent corroboration of integration quality.
